Le JLPT (Japanese-Language Proficiency T: The JLPT (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test) is the most widely recognised Japanese certification for non-native speakers. It has five levels, from N5 (beginner) to N1 (advanced), and is held once or twice a year depending on the country, in July and December. It tests vocabulary, kanji, grammar, reading and listening.

Koto Quest prepares you for it by following the Brothers Grimm’s tales, from Hanau to Bremen, then from the Rhine to the Black Forest and the land of legends; levels A1 to B1 are ready and the next ones are on their way. Mock exams are marked out of 100, with a pass at 60 points (per module from B1); the speaking test is not assessed.
